data.description: Live in Style – Binghatti Hillside with Premium Amenities
data.display_address: Binghatti Hillside, Dubai Science Park, Dubai
data.long_description:
Binghatti Hillside is a vibrant mixed-use development by Binghatti, strategically situated in Dubai Science Park. The project comprises three basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels, 21 floors of residential units, and a rooftop level. It offers a curated selection of studio and one-bedroom apartments, along with dedicated commercial spaces.

The façade is designed in a modern style with clean lines and geometric shapes. Light tones dominate the palette, highlighted by GRC cladding that adds texture to the exterior. Interiors are finished with natural wood, marble, brass details, and mirror inserts. High-quality materials like porcelain tiles and decorative plaster create a refined and welcoming atmosphere.

Amenities include adult and kids' pools, an in-water seating area, a children’s playground, a sports court, and relaxation zones. Residents also have access to gyms with changing rooms and showers.

Located in Dubai Science Park, the project offers easy access to Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road, and Umm Suqeim Street. Nearby are Circle Mall, Dubai Hills Mall, Butterfly Garden, and Miracle Garden. Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Hills Golf Club, and Global Village are 10–15 minutes away, while Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall can be reached in about 20 minutes.
